# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by tools/data_dictionary.py from governance/config/tables.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Owner: set per environment in `governance/config/tables.json`.
Every comment and tag below is applied to Unity Catalog by the `governance` task on each run,
so the catalog and this page cannot drift apart.

## Bronze

Raw source data with audit columns. Not for consumption — read Silver or Gold instead.

### `bronze.customers`

Raw CRM customer extract, exactly as received, plus audit columns.

- **PII:** `tax_id`, `customer_name`, `street`, `number`, `unit`, `ship_to_address`, `lon`, `lat` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=bronze`, `source_system=sqlserver_customers`

### `bronze.sales`

Raw point-of-sale export, product details still JSON text.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=bronze`, `source_system=s3_sales`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `product` | JSON payload of the product sold (parsed in Silver). |
| `total_price` | Line total as exported (= price x qty). |

### `bronze.sales_orders`

Raw web-shop order documents, nested fields still JSON text.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=bronze`, `source_system=cosmos_sales_orders`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ordered_products` | JSON array of line items (parsed in Silver). |
| `clicked_items` | JSON array of [product_id, click_count] pairs. |
| `promo_info` | JSON array of promotions applied to the order. |
| `order_datetime` | Order time as epoch seconds. |

## Silver

Cleaned, typed, de-duplicated entities. History where it matters (SCD Type 2).

### `silver.customers`

Conformed customer master with full change history (SCD2). Filter is_current for the latest version.

- **PII:** `customer_name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `street`, `number`, `unit`, `ship_to_address`, `lon`, `lat`, `tax_id` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=silver`, `scd_type=2`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | Business key from the CRM. |
| `customer_type` | 'individual' (name contains a comma) or 'organisation'. |
| `loyalty_segment_name` | Loyalty label: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum. |
| `is_active` | TRUE while the CRM record is still open (no valid_to). |
| `crm_valid_from` | Validity start of the record in the CRM. |
| `crm_valid_to` | Validity end in the CRM; NULL while active. |

### `silver.sales`

Conformed point-of-sale transactions (SCD1). sale_id is a deterministic hash: the source has no key.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=silver`, `scd_type=1`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `sale_id` | Deterministic SHA-256 over the business columns; stable across reloads. |
| `listed_product_name` | Product name from the export; disagrees with the payload for ~70% of rows. |
| `product_name` | Product actually sold, parsed from the payload (authoritative). |
| `brand` | Brand as reported by the export. |

### `silver.sales_order_clicks`

Products clicked before checkout, one row per order x product (SCD1).

- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=silver`, `scd_type=1`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `click_count` | Number of clicks on the product before checkout. |
| `product_id` | Clicked product; may not have been ordered. |

### `silver.sales_order_lines`

Web-shop order lines, one row per order x line, from the latest version of each order (SCD1).

- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=silver`, `scd_type=1`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `line_number` | 1-based position of the line within the order. |
| `promo_id` | Promotion applied to the line; 'NONE' when there was none. |
| `promo_discount_rate` | Discount rate applied to the line (0 when none). |
| `gross_amount` | quantity x unit_price. |
| `discount_amount` | gross_amount x promo_discount_rate. |
| `net_amount` | gross_amount - discount_amount. Use this for revenue. |

### `silver.sales_orders`

Web-shop order headers with change history (SCD2). Line items are in sales_order_lines.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=silver`, `scd_type=2`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `order_number` | Order business key. |
| `source_document_id` | Cosmos document id; orders versions of the same order. |
| `line_item_count` | Actual number of line items (number_of_line_items is the source's own, sometimes stale, count). |
| `order_gross_amount` | Sum of price x quantity across the lines, before discounts. |
| `click_count` | Total product clicks before checkout. |
| `clicked_item_count` | Distinct products clicked before checkout. |

## Gold

The star schema and the wide views. This is what BI tools and AI agents should query.

### `gold.customers_current`

Current version of every real customer (excludes the Unknown member).

- **PII:** `customer_name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `street`, `number`, `unit`, `ship_to_address`, `lon`, `lat`, `tax_id` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

### `gold.dim_customer`

Customer dimension (SCD2). One row per customer version; customer_sk = -1 is the Unknown member.

- **Primary key:** `customer_sk`
- **PII:** `customer_name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `street`, `number`, `unit`, `ship_to_address`, `lon`, `lat`, `tax_id` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `customer_sk` | Surrogate key, unique per customer version. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown. |
| `customer_id` | Business key from the CRM. |
| `is_current` | TRUE for the latest version. Use customers_current for 'as of today'. |

### `gold.dim_date`

Calendar dimension, one row per day 2015-2030. Join facts on *_date_key.

- **Primary key:** `date_key`
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `date_key` | Surrogate key in yyyymmdd form, e.g. 20260907. |
| `year_month` | yyyy-MM label for time-series charts. |
| `is_weekend` | TRUE on Saturday and Sunday. |

### `gold.dim_product`

Product dimension derived from both channels; there is no product master upstream.

- **Primary key:** `product_sk`
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `product_sk` | Surrogate key. Facts reference this. -1 = Unknown. |
| `brand` | Best-effort brand; see brand_source for how confident to be. |
| `brand_source` | pos_export, name_match, name_prefix or unknown. |

### `gold.dim_promotion`

Promotion dimension derived from the promotions applied to order lines. 'NONE' = no promotion.

- **Primary key:** `promo_id`
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `promo_id` | Promotion code; 'NONE' when no promotion was applied. |
| `promotion_name` | Label including the discount percentage. |
| `discount_rate` | Discount rate the promotion applies. |

### `gold.fact_pos_sale`

Store sales. GRAIN: one row per product sold. Not row-linkable to web orders.

- **Primary key:** `sale_id`
- **Foreign key:** `customer_sk` → `dim_customer` (`customer_sk`)
- **Foreign key:** `product_sk` → `dim_product` (`product_sk`)
- **Foreign key:** `sale_date_key` → `dim_date` (`date_key`)
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `total_amount` | Sale amount (quantity x unit_price). Use this for store revenue. |

### `gold.fact_sales_order`

Web-shop order headers. GRAIN: one row per order (current version).

- **Primary key:** `order_number`
- **Foreign key:** `customer_sk` → `dim_customer` (`customer_sk`)
- **Foreign key:** `order_date_key` → `dim_date` (`date_key`)
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `net_amount` | Sum of the line net amounts. Use this for order-level revenue. |
| `click_count` | Total clicks recorded before checkout. |

### `gold.fact_sales_order_line`

Web-shop order lines. GRAIN: one row per order x line, current version of the order.

- **Primary key:** `order_line_id`
- **Foreign key:** `customer_sk` → `dim_customer` (`customer_sk`)
- **Foreign key:** `product_sk` → `dim_product` (`product_sk`)
- **Foreign key:** `promo_id` → `dim_promotion` (`promo_id`)
- **Foreign key:** `order_date_key` → `dim_date` (`date_key`)
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `order_line_id` | order_number-line_number. |
| `net_amount` | Revenue for the line after the promotion discount. |
| `order_date_key` | FK to dim_date; NULL when the source order had no timestamp. |

### `gold.pos_sales_obt`

One big table: store sales joined to customer, product and date.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

### `gold.sales_order_lines_obt`

One big table: web-shop order lines joined to customer, product, promotion and date. Start here for ad-hoc analysis.

- **PII:** `customer_name` — tagged `pii=true`, restricted by grants
- **Tags:** `classification=internal`, `layer=gold`

## Audit columns

Present on Bronze and Silver tables.

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `_load_date` | Logical load date of the extract. Re-running a date replaces exactly that date's rows. |
| `_ingested_at` | UTC timestamp when the row was written to this table. |
| `_source_file` | Raw file the row was read from (lineage back to the landed bytes). |
| `_row_hash` | SHA-256 over the business columns; used to detect real changes. |
| `_updated_at` | UTC timestamp when this row was last written by the pipeline. |
| `effective_from` | UTC timestamp from which this version is valid. |
| `effective_to` | UTC timestamp until which this version was valid; 9999-12-31 for the current version. |
| `is_current` | TRUE for the latest version of the business key. |
